expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Five nights is the right length for Beijing. You get the wall, the imperial city, the pandas and Universal without rushing any of them.
expert.tip: Start the Forbidden City from the south gate at Tiananmen. Walking north with the crowd keeps you ahead of the big tour groups.

summary: Six days in the Chinese capital with daily breakfast: the Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace, a guided day through Tiananmen Square and the Forbidden City, the panda house at Beijing Zoo and a full day at Universal Studios.
included: Included: 5 nights in Beijing with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; full day guided tour of the Great Wall at Mutianyu and the Summer Palace; guided Beijing city sightseeing tour; Beijing Zoo tickets with the panda house; Universal Studios Beijing tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; China visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
